American Express is a global financial services company whose Information Security and Technology organizations build secure, reliable technology capabilities. The Cybersecurity Engineer I will develop and maintain security-focused web applications, services, integrations, and tooling across frontend and backend systems while supporting a secure software development lifecycle. The role includes coding, testing, debugging, monitoring, collaboration, and improving application security, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.

Responsibilities
Cybersecurity Engineer I develops and maintains software applications, writes secure, clean and efficient code, completes code reviews with guidance and automated testing to ensure high-quality deliverables, debugs software components, and supports and monitors software across various environments
Develops and maintains software applications
Writes clean, efficient, and well-documented code
Completes code reviews and automated testing with guidance from peers and leaders Debugs basic software components and identifies code defects for remediation
Supports and monitors software across test, integration, and production environments Collaborates and co-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives

Experience in distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases
Experience in Agile software development methodologies and practices such as Scrum/Kanban, iterations, user stories
Knowledge of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, NoSQL and relational databases
Knowledge of the core tools used in the planning, analyzing, crafting, building, testing, configuring, and maintaining of assigned application(s)
Experience in automation testing and documentation (i.e. automated, functional, and performance)
Leverage AI tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, documentation, and problem-solving in day-to-day development
Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions
